Build the online foundation before expanding content

This manual describes RPG, an original 2.5D online action RPG with 3D terrain and layered sprite characters. Dedicated-server authority and durable backend transactions are early dependencies. Rich world content follows working ownership, not the reverse.

The first art/terrain lab is small. By Slice A two clients connect, move, transfer individually between zone servers, fight and receive XP. Slice B adds the complete village/economy/profession/quest loop. Later phases add classes, biomes, dungeons, social systems and measured operations.

Source of truth

Edit the human/machine source records under sources/ and run the standard-library Python generator/checks in tools/. Do not hand-edit generated HTML/index tables. Every gameplay asset here is a planned specification, not a compiled Unreal artifact.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
